test_psnr: test the psnr function to compute peak signal-to-noise ratio between two image tensors
test_bit_accuracy: test the bit_accuracy function to compute bit-level accuracy between predicted and target bit tensors
test_vmaf_on_tensor: test the vmaf_on_tensor function to compute VMAF video quality scores between two video tensors
test_bjontegaard_rate: test the bd_rate function to compute Bjontegaard delta rate between two rate-distortion curves
test_tensor_to_video: test the tensor_to_video function to save a video tensor to an MP4 file using ffmpeg
